name: brave-search-api
description: Ground the agent in Brave's independent web index — token-budgeted RAG, cited answers, deep research, news, images, and videos via the bx CLI and Brave Search MCP.

BRAVE_API_KEY.title: Brave Search API key
BRAVE_API_KEY.description: Key from https://api.search.brave.com. Cursor starts the MCP server with this value. Use the same BRAVE_API_KEY in the environment for bx and curl (or run /bx-set-key).
